items.title: Ivanti CVE-2026-104935: Zero-Day Chain Exploited in Operation Innovate
items.content: Ivanti has released emergency security updates after attackers exploited a chain of three zero-day vulnerabilities in Connect Secure VPN appliances to gain root-level access without authentication. items.title: Hirudo: From Fake Updates to Patched Banking Apps
items.content: A new Android banking remote access trojan named Hirudo has been identified, combining credential theft with live remote control. It is delivered through shopping and entertainment apps that act as droppers, installing the trojan as a separate package behind fake update prompts. The malware replaces legitimate banking applications with patched versions that disable security checks from within the... This pulse includes 11 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance. Associated malware: Hirudo.

items.title: ClingSTUN Turns Vulnerable Edge Devices Into Attacker Infrastructure
items.content: An evolving Linux malware campaign deploys ClingSTUN, a back-connect proxy backdoor exploiting known vulnerabilities in Internet-facing IoT and network devices. The malware establishes persistent access and converts compromised systems into remotely controlled proxy nodes. Supporting multiple Linux architectures, ClingSTUN combines boot persistence, process termination, watchdog manipulation,... This pulse includes 89 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: ClingSTUN, Mirai.

items.title: Stolen webcam clips of 900+ victims feed North Korea's $400 million fake Zoom scheme
items.content: North Korean state-sponsored hackers have stolen over $400 million in cryptocurrency during the past 18 months through a sophisticated social engineering operation known as FaceStealer.
